messages:
Samir: Quick sync — proposing a narrow set of client-facing status buckets to simplify retry guidance. current idea: 200 (ok), 4xx (client error), 429 (quota/throttle), 5xx (server/transient), 503 (degraded/capacity), 409 (conflict). Thoughts?
Priya: Love simplifying buckets. main worry: 503 vs 429 overlap when we're limiting because of quota vs capacity. how would console badge differentiate?
Jordan: From SDK POV we need deterministic retry hints in headers. Suggest standard headers like `X-RW-Retry-Hint: none|immediate|delayed` and `X-RW-Status: ok|degraded|fallback|overquota`. Can map to policy easily.
Eve: Console wants a single badge per-route that maps to an internal signal shape: `{type, severity, impact_link}`. Tooltip should be friendly — no raw codes. e.g., "Degraded — partial capacity; some requests are served by a smaller model."
Mateo: Telemetry ask: emit `error_category` (client/quota/compute), `route_id`, `model_variant`, `tenant_id`, and `origin` (routing|fallback|primary). Also include `fallback_reason` when applicable. sample: `fallback_reason=capacity`. Keep sampling for client errors (high volume).
Samir: Proposal: keep HTTP status semantics but add machine-readable headers for clients and console. header names: `X-RW-Status` and `X-RW-Retry-Hint`. This avoids breaking existing infra but gives deterministic signals.
Priya: Browser note — we'll need to expose headers via CORS (Access-Control-Expose-Headers). doc that in SDK and console docs.
Jordan: Agree. SDK will implement mapping. Example mapping idea: `Retry-After` or `X-RW-Retry-Hint` precedence. Also prefer short values to keep telemetry cardinality low.
Eve: UX specs: badge colors: green/amber/red. message copy should be product-friendly, e.g., "Limited capacity — degraded results" rather than "503". Tooltip includes link to runbook and route-level logs.
Mateo: For telemetry payloads please avoid embedding PII. Example event we want when fallback happens: `event=fallback` `route=text-gen` `reason=capacity` `fallback_to=rtx-small` `sample_rate=0.01`.
Samir: Quick header example to include in RFC:
```
X-RW-Status: degraded
X-RW-Retry-Hint: delayed
X-RW-Fallback-To: rtx-small
```
Jordan: SDK pseudocode mapping we'll implement:
```
if headers['X-RW-Retry-Hint'] == 'immediate':
  retry(attempts=1, backoff=200ms)
elif headers['X-RW-Retry-Hint'] == 'delayed':
  schedule_retry(30s)
else:
  surface_to_user()
```
Priya: Product request: console route details should show most recent failure cause per-tenant and a 7d histogram of `X-RW-Status` values so devs can debug regressions. Also a toggle to see raw headers when troubleshooting.
Eve: Rollout UX: when canarying header changes, support dual-writing both v1 and v2 headers for a window (2w). use versioned headers: `X-RW-Status-v1` / `X-RW-Status-v2` to keep parsing deterministic.
Mateo: Ops alerting: rule suggestion — if `fraction(X-RW-Status=degraded) > 0.5%` across global traffic for 5m, page #eng-oncall. Otherwise surface to infra-monitoring as a warning. Also log fallback reasons to trace.
Samir: Action items: Jordan - implement SDK header mapping RFC + tests; Eve - draft badge copy + tooltip + runbook link; Mateo - add telemetry keys, sampling guidance, and alert rules; Priya - update product docs and quota wording. I'll draft the RFC this afternoon and share for review.
Priya: Thanks! One more: can we add a short client-friendly message header like `X-RW-User-Message: "You're on a lower-capacity variant; try again later"` for quick surface in SDK UIs? Keep it opt-in.
Jordan: We can expose it but flag it behind opt-in config in SDKs to avoid clutter.
Samir: Noted. Also remember CORS exposure. I'll include CORS checklist in RFC.
Priya: Cool. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary post-RFC so we can test header propagation across CDN -> edge -> runtime?
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1718310000. Will post status to #eng-platform when it completes. :rocket: 
Eve: leaving a note to use friendly language only in UI; raw codes only in "advanced" view.
Mateo: I'll add a replica test to simulate capacity fallback and ensure `fallback_reason` is emitted.
Samir: Perfect. RFC draft link (wip): https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026-status-headers. Please comment inline.
Priya: Great sync. I'll collect UX examples from other providers and paste here tomorrow. :+1:
